verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions is a built-in, GitHub Actions-compatible CI/CD system: users define YAML workflows and can reuse existing Actions plugins. That gives them their own declarative automation, and webhooks let them build custom event-driven workflows. The core of the story is delivered, but the evidence only implies event triggers through GitHub Actions compatibility rather than listing them. missing for 10: explicit documentation of supported trigger events and conditions, evidence of rule-based automation beyond CI (e.g., issue/PR automation rules), independent hands-on corroboration of Gitea Actions.
